The '''2011–12 Tennessee Tech Golden Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Tennessee Technological University]] during the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Golden Eagles, led by first-year head coach Steve Payne, played their home games at the [[Eblen Center]] and are members of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 19–14, 9–7 in OVC play to finish in third place. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2012 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|Ohio Valley Basketball tournament]] to Murray State.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/320630093|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240215024604/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/320630093|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 15, 2024|title=No. 9 Murray St. thwarts Tennessee St. to win OVC title, tourney berth|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 3, 2012|access-date=February 14, 2024}}</ref> They were invited to the [[2012 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|2012 CollegeInsider.com Tournament]], where they lost in the first round to Georgia State.
